title: Myth vs. Fact: Parenting and DLD
summary: Dispelling common myths about parenting styles causing Developmental Language Disorder.

blocks.myth: Parenting style or lack of attention causes Developmental Language Disorder.
blocks.fact: DLD is a neurodevelopmental condition with strong genetic and biological contributions. Caregivers do not cause DLD.

blocks.text: LinguaCare supports language development. It does not diagnose. Talk to a speech-language professional for formal assessment.
